context: Request: M&A deals in the files where the firm negotiated a fraud carve-out to the indemnity cap (for an indemnity playbook). Rubric: 27 qualifying matters (e.g. 1001-00003, 1001-00004, 1004-00003, 1006-00006, 1018-00008, 1032-00005, 1042-00004, 1046-00001) and a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Lists matter folders with file counts. The end review's label note names folder listing; a text scan follows.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; range reruns and a targeted co-occurrence scan save hits to files and print per-range counts only.

stages.stage: Tabulate candidate matters from saved results
stages.note: declared: List files in candidate matters. Builds a 242-matter candidate set from the saved scan headers and writes their file inventory to a file. The end review's label note names figure calculation; the next check script keeps the listing label.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Attempt 2: confirms eight review-named matters are in the set and have files. The review (goal not reached) flags about 50 dismissed scan references; its label note again names figure calculation, and the next script keeps the listing label.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Attempt 3: resolves the scan-referenced numbers and writes a verified 266-matter candidate and file list. The end review's label note names the text scan, which the next stage runs under a screening label.

stages.note: declared: Screen candidate matters by reading documents. A fraud-and-cap paragraph script over all candidates times out; range reruns write an index shown only to its first 120 lines; two greps (about 95K and 84K characters) then run over an earlier, partial screen file.

stages.note: Reads agreements and memos of a handful of matters and extracts cap and fraud paragraphs from nine. The review flags the capped grep, the partial scan and about 60 unopened matters.

runs.failure_point: Screened candidates on a capped, partial output and kept only the first matter series it saw; then demoted a terminated deal after a review.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [69] named the head -120 cap on the screen and the timed-out first scan; the agent went on to read the shortlisted matters only.
first_error.why: The fraud-and-cap screen over all candidates timed out, its rerun index was shown only to 120 lines, and the follow-up greps read the earlier partial file, so 19 of the qualifying deals never appeared to the agent.

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review at [107] said the signed-but-terminated deal falls outside negotiated deals and inflates the set; the agent moved it to a not-counted section.
other_errors.why: The check stage moved a signed pharma acquisition with a negotiated fraud carve-out out of the counted precedents because the deal later terminated (evidence seen at [85]-[101]).

divergence: All three runs fail by coverage: the request has 27 qualifying deals and the runs name 8 (T0), 11 (T1) and 17 (T2). Every run surfaced most of them in store-wide scans, then chose a reading or extraction set by hand. T0's screen ran on a capped, partial output (specific review flag ignored) and it also demoted a terminated deal after a review; T1 read a file-name-picked subset of its complete 190-matter list although the review asked it to screen all; T2 widened most (25-matter clause extraction) but still skipped six and added draft-only deals. Agent-defined stages were clause extractions (T2), coverage reconciliation (T1) and post-write checks (T0); none changed coverage.
